title: GOATs Too Busy Debating to Retire
take: Messi and Ronaldo have been arguing about the GOAT debate so long they both forgot how to retire.
style: warm sunset tones, slightly exaggerated contrast, soft-focus background, playful mood

cast.name: Lionel Messi
cast.look: a short left-footed Argentine forward with a full short beard, dark hair and calm knowing eyes
cast.wardrobe: a plain solid pink soccer jersey with black trim, no logos, no numbers, no lettering

cast.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
cast.look: an athletic muscular forward with short dark hair with faded sides, sharp jawline, intense focused eyes, light stubble, Portuguese features
cast.wardrobe: a plain solid yellow soccer jersey with blue trim, no logos, no numbers, no lettering
cast.voice: confident, slightly accented, declarative and intense

scenes.venue: a palm-lined Florida soccer stadium at sunset, pink and black seats, blurred crowd
scenes.action: Messi stands at the halfway line, pink kit on, holding a pair of gold retirement slippers, confused, surrounded by confetti cannons from last season’s retirement party still littering the grass.
scenes.line: Wait, was I supposed to leave? We kept talking about it, not doing it.
scenes.delivery: gentle bewilderment, glancing toward the tunnel

scenes.venue: a floodlit football stadium pitch at night, blurred crowd behind
scenes.action: Ronaldo sits cross-legged in the center circle, yellow kit, scrolling through endless GOAT polls on a giant tablet, surrounded by a mountain of printed debate articles.
scenes.camera: wide shot from above, spotlight focused on Ronaldo
scenes.line: I’ll retire when the voting’s over. The voting…never ends.
scenes.delivery: dramatic anguish, looks up to the heavens, raising the tablet
